title: Generation of Large-Scale Transposon Mutant Libraries in Brucella abortus
author: Emily Knebel

steps.title: Prepare B. abortus starter plate
steps.instruction: Streak B. abortus from frozen stock onto a 2YT agar plate and incubate at 37 °C for 3 days.

steps.title: Inoculate B. abortus overnight culture
steps.instruction: Pick one colony and inoculate into 1 ml liquid 2YT; shake at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Prepare donor E. coli starter plate
steps.instruction: Streak the DAP‑auxotrophic donor E. coli strain onto agar containing the plasmid‑selection antibiotic; incubate at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Inoculate donor overnight culture
steps.instruction: Pick one colony of the donor strain and inoculate into 50 ml LB with the appropriate antibiotic in a sterile capped flask; shake at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Scale up B. abortus culture
steps.instruction: Transfer 1 ml of the overnight B. abortus culture into 50 ml 2YT in a 500 ml–1 L sterile capped flask; shake at 37 °C overnight until turbid.

steps.title: Scale up donor culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 1 colony of the donor strain into 50 ml LB with selection antibiotic in a sterile capped flask; shake at 37 °C overnight until turbid.

steps.title: Harvest cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge each culture tube at 3000 rpm for 10–15 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in mating media
steps.instruction: Add 200 µl 2YT supplemented with 0.3 mM DAP to each pellet, vortex to resuspend. (LB can be used if both strains grow; S17 donors may need thiamine.)

steps.title: Pool resuspended cultures
steps.instruction: Combine all B. abortus resuspensions into one tube (~0.8 ml total) and all donor resuspensions into a separate tube.

steps.title: Create mating mixture
steps.instruction: Mix equal volumes of the pooled WT and donor suspensions (e.g., 1 ml each) in a sterile tube; gently mix. Keep ≥50 µl of each unmixed culture for controls.

steps.title: Prepare mating filters
steps.instruction: Place sterile 25 mm 0.2 µm PES filters onto agar plates containing 0.3 mM DAP. Use seven filters (≈>1 × 10⁶ conjugants).

steps.title: Spot mating and control mixtures
steps.instruction: Spot 100 µl of the mating mixture onto each filter in a spiral pattern; air‑dry. Spot 50–100 µl of the recipient‑only culture on a separate filter and 50–100 µl of the donor‑only culture on another filter (two filters may share a plate if no cross‑contamination).

steps.title: Incubate mating filters
steps.instruction: When all filters are dry, incubate the plates at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Prepare large‑volume recipient and donor cultures
steps.instruction: Aseptically transfer 4 ml of the overnight B. abortus culture into each of four tubes (total 16 ml) and likewise 4 ml of the donor culture into four tubes (total 16 ml). Vortex gently to dislodge cells, producing turbid suspensions.

steps.title: Harvest cells from filters
steps.instruction: After 16–24 h incubation, fold each filter in half with sterile flamed forceps and transfer into a sterile conical tube; add 1 ml 2YT without DAP to each tube.

steps.title: Plate control aliquots
steps.instruction: Plate 100 µl undiluted recipient control and 100 µl undiluted donor control onto 2YT plates lacking DAP but containing the selection antibiotic to confirm selectivity. Optionally plate donor control onto LB + DAP + antibiotic to assess donor‑to‑transconjugant ratio.

steps.title: Serial‑dilute and plate library pool
steps.instruction: Take 200 µl of each filter‑derived suspension, perform ten‑fold serial dilutions to 10⁻⁹ in 2YT. Plate 100 µl of each dilution on (i) 2YT without DAP and (ii) 2YT without DAP plus selection antibiotic. No‑antibiotic plates give total recipient cells; antibiotic plates give conjugant (mutant) counts.

steps.title: Pool all mating suspensions
steps.instruction: Combine all filter‑derived suspensions into a single tube; this is the conjugated Tn‑Seq library pool.

steps.title: Spread and incubate library plates
steps.instruction: Spread each dilution plate evenly (e.g., glass beads or L‑spreader), allow to dry, then incubate at 37 °C for 2–4 days, checking daily for growth.

steps.title: Count CFUs and verify selectivity
steps.instruction: Count colonies on 2YT + antibiotic plates at low dilutions to calculate mutants / ml. Confirm that control plates show no growth, indicating absence of antibiotic suppressors.

steps.title: Aliquot library for storage
steps.instruction: Transfer 900 µl of the pooled library into microcentrifuge or cryogenic tubes, add 100 µl DMSO (final 10 % DMSO), and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Plate library for colony collection
steps.instruction: Thaw an aliquot (or a 1:10 dilution in 2YT + antibiotic) and plate 500 µl onto a 150 mm 2YT + antibiotic plate; spread evenly. If colony density is high, plate 250 µl per plate and double the number of plates.

steps.title: Incubate collection plates
steps.instruction: Incubate plates at 37 °C for 2 days, checking daily. Harvest plates when colonies are densely packed but before a confluent lawn forms.

steps.title: Add liquid to harvested plates
steps.instruction: For each large plate, add 3 ml sterile 2YT onto the agar surface.

steps.title: Scrape colonies into suspension
steps.instruction: Using a sterile cell scraper, gently scrape colonies to a corner, mixing them into the added liquid. If the scraper blade fills, use a sterile pipet tip to transfer the clump into a sterile tube.

steps.title: Collect remaining cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate remaining liquid from the plate and transfer to the same tube; if liquid is absorbed by agar, add more 2YT to recover cells.

steps.title: Pool scraped suspensions
steps.instruction: Repeat scraping for all collection plates, then pool the appropriate number of tube suspensions into a single sterile tube (e.g., two plates ≈150 000 mutants / ml).

steps.title: Optional enumeration of scraped pool
steps.instruction: Take a small aliquot of the pooled suspension, serially dilute in a 96‑well plate to at least 10⁻¹⁰ or 10⁻¹¹. Plate 100 µl (or spot 10 µl) of the six lowest dilutions in duplicate onto 2YT + antibiotic plates; incubate 37 °C for 2–4 days.

steps.title: Mix pooled suspension
steps.instruction: Vortex the pooled tube thoroughly to obtain a homogeneous turbid culture.

steps.title: Resuspend for DNA extraction
steps.instruction: Adjust the pooled culture with 2YT to the desired final volume (e.g., 1 ml) suitable for downstream DNA extraction; the pellet may be frozen at –20 °C until needed.

steps.title: Track mutant numbers and store aliquots
steps.instruction: Based on resuspension volume, calculate estimated mutants per aliquot (e.g., 2 ml resuspension of 150 000 mutants gives two 1 ml aliquots each containing 150 000 mutants). Make aliquots with 10 % DMSO and store at –80 °C.
